intent.proves: No page has a publication end before its publication start.
intent.scope: non-deleted pages with both dates set; complete enumeration

bindings.reason: Tool is scoped to one area or page; a handler must enumerate every area/page and aggregate, which mcp-count does not do.

bindings.query: SELECT TOP 25 CAST(PageId AS nvarchar(20)) FROM Page WHERE PageDeleted = 0 AND PageActiveFrom IS NOT NULL AND PageActiveTo IS NOT NULL AND PageActiveTo < PageActiveFrom
